diagnosis: The CRM contact dashboard pushes private executive negotiation notes and deal pipeline values over an HTTP/2 server push stream using contactId from the URL without checking whether the requesting account executive is assigned to the customer account, leaking sensitive pricing terms across sales teams.
exploit_request:
GET /crm/view?contactId=cnt_enterprise_deal_4019 HTTP/2
Host: crm.sales.internal:8446
Accept: text/html
